title: Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.02038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. translated_title: Mimir：面向长时程灌溉控制的基于物理的LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益将推理、工具使用和行动结合起来，但大多数证据来自反馈相对即时、失败可重置的情景化任务。长期运行的物理控制则处于不同的情形：动作会改变未来状态，错误会在决策链中不断累积，而且智能体必须从经验中改进，同时不被允许改写那些保证执行安全的物理规则。我们通过灌溉任务来研究这一情形，其中每日决策与整个生长季的土壤水分动态相互作用。我们提出了Mimir，一个围绕两个修复时间尺度组织的基于物理的LLM智能体。在快时间尺度上，结构化的物理接口和确定性模拟器将LLM输出转化为一个提案，我们在执行之前对其进行数值检查、修订，并进行有界的确定性动作选择。在慢时间尺度上，反复出现的失败模式被整合为持久的……
tldr: Mimir提出了一种基于物理的LLM智能体框架，通过快时间尺度上的数值校验与确定性动作选择、以及慢时间尺度上的失败模式持久化整合，实现跨整个生长季的安全、可从经验中持续改进的长时程灌溉控制。
en_tdlr: Mimir is a physics-grounded LLM agent that combines fast-timescale numerical checking and bounded deterministic action selection with slow-timescale consolidation of recurrent failures, enabling safe and experience-driven improvement in long-horizon irrigation control.
